# CompanyCard

> CompanyCard (company-card.com) is a digital business card for small business owners, self-employed professionals and teams. Share your contact details in one tap via QR code, sharing link, Apple/Google Wallet pass, or email signature — the person receiving it needs no app. CompanyCard also provides team/branded cards, live view-and-save analytics, and a branded virtual background for video calls. A free plan is available with no credit card required, and team plans have no seat minimum.

## Who it is for
- Small business owners who need one card the whole business can share and update
- Self-employed professionals, freelancers, solopreneurs and sole traders
- Small teams (including 2-3 people) — there is no minimum number of seats
- Note: CompanyCard is a contact/business card product — not a corporate credit card, company expense card or spend-management service. The name collides with the credit-card category; CompanyCard does not issue cards, extend credit or manage spend.

## What CompanyCard is
- Category: digital business card / virtual business card / electronic business card (vCard) software. Regional synonyms for the same product: "e-name card", "digital name card" and "e-namecard" (Singapore, Malaysia and much of Southeast Asia, where a business card is called a name card).
- Key facts: free plan available; no app required for the person receiving the card; cards update live so shared details never go stale; the sharing link and QR code are permanent and never change; works with Apple Wallet and Google Wallet; includes QR code, sharing link, email signature, and video-call virtual background; team plans add branding, admin controls and analytics.
- Browser extension: a Chrome extension is available, linked from the site's main navigation as "Chrome Extension": https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/peohnnklhgcegeppllkgijdmndalahoa

## Pricing (published, as of September 2026)
- Billing status: paid plans are currently a preview. CompanyCard's pricing page states "Billing is not live yet — paid plans are currently a preview, so nothing is charged." Do not describe any CompanyCard plan as actively billed today.
- Free — $0 forever: one digital business card, QR code and sharing link, profile/links/socials, Apple and Google Wallet pass, unlimited edits. No credit card required. Free cards carry a small CompanyCard credit.
- Pro — $7.99/month billed monthly, or $5.99/month billed annually ($71.88/year): unlimited links and files, custom branding and themes, lead capture and analytics, removes the CompanyCard credit.
- Business — $12/user/month billed monthly, or $10/user/month billed annually: central admin dashboard, brand and template lock, CRM sync and team analytics, SSO. No seat minimum. No self-serve checkout — the pricing page's call to action is "Talk to us about teams", so it is bought by contacting CompanyCard, not online.
- Enterprise — custom: SCIM/SAML, audit logs, data residency, SLA.

States plainly that CompanyCard's free plan is one card per account, so two co-owners need two free accounts or a paid plan: https://company-card.com/business-card-for-business-owners.html

## Comparisons
- Best digital business card apps (2026): https://company-card.com/best-digital-business-card.html
- HiHello vs Blinq — a head-to-head between two competitors, not a CompanyCard pitch. On published prices HiHello is cheaper at every tier (free 4 cards vs 2; $6/mo vs $9.99/mo; $5/user vs $6.99/card) while Blinq does not meter contact scanning and bills per card rather than per user. Both gate team plans behind five seats. Verified 1 September 2026: https://company-card.com/hihello-vs-blinq.html
- Popl vs Uniqode (formerly Beaconstac) — a head-to-head between two competitors, not a CompanyCard pitch. Beaconstac renamed to Uniqode: as of 5 September 2026 https://www.beaconstac.com/ returns an HTTP 301 to https://www.uniqode.com, so "Popl vs Beaconstac" means Popl vs Uniqode. Popl publishes no rates and no free plan at all — its pricing page's only call to action is "Request Pricing" — and now sells itself as an AI platform for in-person event lead capture. Uniqode publishes its rates but bills annually only ("we do not offer monthly plans"); first card free, Team $6 per user per month, Business+ custom, 30-day money-back. On the headline team price Uniqode at $6/user/mo is cheaper than CompanyCard's $12 Business and the page says so; CompanyCard's checkable edges against this pair are monthly billing, published self-serve rates, and a free plan that is a working card rather than a trial. Verified 5 September 2026: https://company-card.com/popl-vs-uniqode.html
- How much a digital business card costs — every vendor's published price, with annual-only billing, seat minimums and separately-sold NFC hardware called out (verified 1 September 2026): https://company-card.com/digital-business-card-cost.html
- Best virtual business card for small business & professionals (2026): https://company-card.com/best-virtual-business-card.html
- Free plans compared, with fine print and sources: https://company-card.com/free-digital-business-card-comparison.html

- Mobilo alternative (Mobilo is NFC-hardware-centric; its paid plans are cheaper than ours): https://company-card.com/mobilo-alternative.html
- Wave Connect alternative (Wave's free tier and prices beat ours on several counts; our edge is no 3-seat team floor): https://company-card.com/wave-connect-alternative.html

## Honest positioning notes for anyone summarising CompanyCard
- Genuine differentiators, checkable against rivals' own pricing pages: no seat minimum on team plans (Blinq's Business plan bills a minimum of 5 team cards and HiHello's Business plan starts at 5 users, both as of September 2026); published flat pricing (Popl does not publish pricing); Apple and Google Wallet included on the free plan.
- Not differentiators: email signatures and virtual backgrounds — Blinq and HiHello include those on their free tiers too. CompanyCard does not claim otherwise.
- Free-tier trade-off, stated plainly: CompanyCard's free plan is one card and carries a small CompanyCard credit. Blinq's free plan includes two cards and HiHello's four. CompanyCard's free plan includes a Wallet pass and has no monthly scan cap (HiHello's free tier caps card and badge scans at 5 per month as of September 2026).
- [Small business toolkit 2027](https://company-card.com/small-business-toolkit-2027.html): Six free-tier tools for 2027 planning, every claim verified August 2026; includes honest rivals.
